info.name: AISafe - Maintenance Service (WP#4)
info.description: Maintenance service with 3 replicas (8082/8182/8282) and Aircraft Management (8081/8181/8281). Start Aircraft Management and Maintenance with the demo data (scripts/start-replicas.* <service> demo); Flight Routes is needed for the flight-hour part of US222. Run folders 0-8 in order; stop replica 2 before folder 9.

exec: const d = new Date(); pm.environment.set("today", d.toISOString().slice(0,10));
const f = new Date(Date.now() + 5*86400000); pm.environment.set("future", f.toISOString().slice(0,10));

item.name: List templates (reference templates in every replica, no duplicates)

exec: pm.test("Reference templates present once", () => { const names = t.map(x => x.name); pm.expect(names).to.include("A-Check Inspection"); pm.expect(names.filter(n => n === "A-Check Inspection").length).to.eql(1); });
const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Template data", () => { pm.expect(b.type).to.eql("MODIFICATION"); pm.expect(b._links).to.have.property("self"); });

pm.test("IN_PROGRESS with the template checklist and links", () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("IN_PROGRESS"); pm.expect(b.checklist.length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(b._links).to.have.property("complete"); });

exec: pm.test("Every replica counted", () => { const regs = h.aircraft.map(a => a.aircraftRegistration); pm.expect(regs).to.include.members(["CS-TUA","CS-TUB","CS-TUC","CS-TUD","CS-TUE"]); pm.expect(h.totalHours).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test("Average = total / count (after adding replicas)", () => pm.expect(a320.averageMinutes).to.be.closeTo(a320.totalMinutes / a320.completedRecords, 0.01));
pm.test("Alerts with trigger and message", () => { pm.expect(alerts.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(alerts[0]).to.have.property("trigger"); pm.expect(alerts[0]).to.have.property("message"); });
pm.test("CS-TUB has an ongoing C-Check, so no C-Check alert", () => pm.expect(alerts.filter(a => a.aircraftRegistration === "CS-TUB" && a.templateName.startsWith("C-Check")).length).to.eql(0));
